V. 23.
In Solomon's portico—Ioſephus informs us, that when Solomon built the Temple, he filled up a Part of the adjacent Valley, and built a Portico over it towards the Eaſt. This was a noble Structure, ſupported by a Wall four hundred Cubits high; and continued even to the time of Albinus and Agrippa, which was ſeveral Years after the Death of Chriſt.
